title: THE PLAGUE AND THE POWERLESS COPY

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Then the Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, 'Stretch out your hand with your staff over the streams and canals and ponds, and make frogs come up on the land of Egypt.'" So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land. But the magicians did the same things by their secret arts; they also made frogs come up on the land of Egypt." - Exodus 8:5-7 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Egypt worshipped a goddess associated with frogs, connected with fertility and new life. Now the symbol of life is multiplying until it becomes unbearable. God has a way of letting an idol overwhelm its worshippers.

And once more the magicians match the miracle. But think about what they actually achieve. Egypt is drowning in frogs, and their solution is to produce more frogs.

They can add to the problem. They cannot remove it.

That is the honest limit of every counterfeit. Human systems can imitate power, but they cannot deliver. A self-help programme can multiply resolutions; it cannot forgive a sin. Religion can multiply rituals; it cannot change a heart.

Notice what happens in the very next verse — Pharaoh sends for Moses. Even he understands that his own magicians are useless for the one thing that matters.

When you need something removed rather than repeated, there is only one place to go.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where have I been adding to a problem instead of bringing it to God?
2. What in my life needs to be removed, not merely managed?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, I cannot fix what I have made worse. I bring it to You, the only one who can take it away. Amen.
